description: This script automates setup and configuration tasks for ERPNext, including creating custom fields, roles, user types, default settings, and navigation items during installation.

methods.name: after_install
methods.description: Performs post-installation setup tasks such as creating roles, custom fields, default settings, and navigation items.

methods.name: check_setup_wizard_not_completed
methods.description: Checks if the setup wizard has been completed; throws an error if it has.

methods.name: set_single_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for various system settings and document fields.

methods.name: create_compact_item_print_custom_field
methods.description: Creates a custom field for compact item print in Print Settings.

methods.name: create_print_uom_after_qty_custom_field
methods.description: Creates a custom field to print UOM after quantity in Print Settings.

methods.name: create_print_zero_amount_taxes_custom_field
methods.description: Creates a custom field to print taxes with zero amount in Print Settings.

methods.name: create_default_cash_flow_mapper_templates
methods.description: Creates default cash flow mapper templates if they do not exist.

methods.name: create_default_success_action
methods.description: Creates default success actions if they do not exist.

methods.name: create_default_energy_point_rules
methods.description: Creates default energy point rules if they do not exist.

methods.name: add_company_to_session_defaults
methods.description: Adds the Company doctype to session defaults.

methods.name: add_standard_navbar_items
methods.description: Adds standard navigation items to the help dropdown in the navbar.

methods.name: add_app_name
methods.description: Sets the application name in system settings to 'ERPNext'.

methods.name: add_non_standard_user_types
methods.description: Creates custom user types and roles, and updates site configuration for user type limits.

methods.name: get_user_types_data
methods.description: Returns data for the 'Employee Self Service' user type, including roles and permissions.

methods.name: create_custom_role
methods.description: Creates a custom role if it does not already exist.

methods.name: create_user_type
methods.description: Creates or updates a user type with associated roles and permissions.

methods.name: create_role_permissions_for_doctype
methods.description: Assigns permissions for each doctype to a user type.

methods.name: update_select_perm_after_install
methods.description: Updates select permissions for non-standard user types after migration.
